**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Close PLAN-adapters-v3 Track B (the SDD_HARNESS port) via the B2 Antigravity baptism, after finishing the B2 Half-1 link-rebase fix and the #247 scope-check.

## Instructions
- Old issues get re-measured against the base branch BEFORE approve — counts are point-in-time measurements, not authority.
- The baptism runs through Antigravity ALONE (human operator); Claude Code observes, never co-implements — four hands contaminate the n=2.
- No gate may be weakened for the new inhabitant — a gate that must change to pass is a STOP-finding.
- Never AI-attribution in commits; never self-apply status:approved; doc-zone promotes only via human MR.

## Discoveries
- The #247 "3 chunk-consumer sites" was stale: really 2 CODE sites (brain-audit.mjs, brain-check.mjs) + 2 transitive invokers of brain-audit (release.yml:43, governance-postmerge.yml:42). Original table mis-paired release.yml with brain-check.
- Antigravity CLI settings live at ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json (nested), NOT ~/.gemini/settings.json. permissions.allow = exact-invocation allowlist (append-on-first-approve), no prefix grants. enableTelemetry:false (SCIT-relevant), trustedWorkspaces[] auto-adds clones (cleanup needed).
- actor-check RED on the baptism is a correct DETECTION: on the human-approves/human-commits axis a solo operator is the same person; the real separation (approve-issue / implement / external-review) lives on a different axis than the one actor-check inspects.

## Accomplished
- B2 Half-1 link-rebase fix: compileAgentsMd rebases 36 relative links to emit location; AGENTS.md regenerated; drift-guard byte-equal; hermetic; 1446/1446; counted diff 204/400. #257 body + checkpoint-report updated.
- #247 body corrected to the honest scope (2 code sites + 2 named transitive invokers + chunk-reader retirement verdict inside slice; struck the pre-receive push-rejection acceptance as CP-A4a scope bleed). Human applied status:approved.
- THE BAPTISM: #258 merged — Antigravity solo migrated the 2 consumers to records, retired chunk-reader, gates/engram/managed-paths intact, conventional commits no AI attribution, full SDD+TDD, 1440/1440. Track B PROVEN end-to-end at n=2 with a real second AI inhabitant, gates untouched.
- 3 baptism findings logged (scope-creep bounded by governance; base-branch fixed by re-base not gate-change → runbook fix: kickoff prompt must specify --base feature/v2.0.0; actor-check RED explained).

## Next Steps
- Merge #257 (B2 Half 1) if not yet + the human's inaugural read of AGENTS.md.
- The SCIT bundle (endpoint-gated): CP-A2b smoke + CP-A3b + recorder-gitlab — the one remaining key is a live endpoint.
- Cleanup: strip scratch/clone entries from Antigravity trustedWorkspaces[].

## Relevant Files
- brain/scripts/harness/backends/antigravity.mjs — the harness backend (compileAgentsMd + init)
- openspec/changes/issue-256-b2/runbook-baptism.md — the baptism operating doc (§1 settings location now confirmed)
- GitHub #247 (corrected+approved), #258 (baptism, merged), #257 (B2 Half 1)
